reactionDistribution.title: How fast are players? Best five-round averages
reactionDistribution.aria: Histogram of best reaction time averages from 12,157 players. Most players fall between 280 and 440 ms, peaking at 340 to 359 ms. The median is 368 ms.
reactionDistribution.caption: 12,157 players, March 8 to November 27, 2026, each counted once with their best result. Bars are 20 ms wide; 281 players between 800 and 1,000 ms are not shown.
